description_en: Queries the diagnostic information about a Spark SQL query
description_zh: 查询单个Spark SQL的诊断详情
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-spark-sql-diagnosis-attribute --db-cluster-id amv-2zeq4788qyy7k662 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --app-id s202411071444hzdvk486d9d20010000 --inner-query-id 1 --biz-language zh --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeSparkSQLDiagnosisAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.



You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters within a region, including cluster IDs
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html接口查看目标地域下所有的集群信息，包括集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。

parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:

应用ID。
调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612475.html接口查询Spark应用的ID
